description: Queue ISMS document generation for one or more generators (write — admin role). Returns a task_id; poll scf_get_document_generation_status. Existing documents are skipped unless force is set.

force.description: Regenerate even when a document already exists for that generator and domain (default false)

requests.description: Between 1 and 40 generation requests to queue in this batch

domain_id.description: SCF domain ID from scf_list_document_domains — required by domain-scoped generators

generator.description: Generator name from scf_list_document_generators, e.g. 'soa' or 'governance-report' (the Governance Oversight Report for board due-care review; not domain-scoped)

name: scf_generate_documents
